claims.claim: KA-01 v1.0 exists as a standalone HUMAN_RATIFIED_PROSPECTIVE_SPEC marked NOT_ACTIVATED, with prospective-only legal effect and explicit preservation of the Constitution, frozen Kernel v0.1 and historical lineage.
The addendum maps §§3, 4.1–4.5, 5, 7, 9, 10, 11 and 12, including all fifteen Kernel laws, and limits the automatic-retry exception to future opted-in ACTIVE PRIMARY preterminal continuation.

The future-version contract separates reviewed semantic obligations and mappings from executable plans, keeps consent, delegation and budgets operational, and preserves legacy decoding and current V2 behavior.

The transition specification defines monotonic committed candidates, checkpoints and factual feedback under one sticky Executor and admitted ACTIVE PRIMARY, exactly one terminal outcome, and separate postterminal AUTHOR_REPAIR and REMEDIATION.

The addendum restricts feedback to typed facts, preserves Executor ownership of HOW, and specifies scope, risk, semantic-choice, live-lease, profile, finite-budget, progress and crash/replay fail-closed guards.

The addendum requires authenticated source-to-target applicability with VALID, INVALIDATED and UNKNOWN over full relevant footprints, preserves distinct integration/concurrency/ordering proofs, prohibits false subject relabeling and equivalent duplicate execution, and requires all BR-1..BR-6 before base replay.

Separate ratification, publication, engineering, actual measurement, AC-01..AC-36 conformance, activation and rollback gates are defined; VP-01 remains deferred, VP-03..VP-07 require independent authorization, downstream adoption remains separate, and no production-readiness or savings claim is made.
The final commit changes only the KA-01 document and one concise README governance pointer; the worktree is clean.
